d: Years after that 2018 Cape Town ball-tampering scandal, Australian cricket still can't agree on what actually happened, and Usman Khawaja's claims about how widely Sandpapergate was known have just ripped the whole thing open again, but Pat Cummins has come out and flatly rejected his version of events, and with David Warner and Mitchell Starc also weighing in with completely different takes, it leaves you wondering if Australian cricket ever told the complete story of the Newlands scandal, so Rupha Ramani looks at the competing narratives, the players involved, and why this uncomfortable…
